chunks.text: Revenue grew 15% YoY driven by strong demand across all segments.
Net income reached $345.7M, reflecting disciplined cost management.
The company continued to invest in R&D and capital expenditures.
Accounts payable increased modestly as supplier terms were renegotiated.
Gross margin remained stable at approximately 45%, in line with prior year.
The balance sheet remains strong with a healthy equity ratio.
Operating margin was 21.7%, reflecting ongoing efficiency initiatives.
The company demonstrated strong cash generation with robust operating cash flows.
Customer acquisition costs declined year-over-year, improving unit economics.
Management remains focused on long-term value creation for shareholders.
